name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_no_change_reason: REVIEW gate (#209) adds the ReviewVerdict schema + REVIEW non-acting agent-state + the auto-maintainer-reviewer subagent; INTEGRATE ANDs review-approval into its merge condition. This is the model-backed verify/integrate policy the spec's deprecation_criterion already anticipated.
